name: Don't DNF Denton 2023
information:
***This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3. This competition features blindfolded events, Clock, and FMC. For a more normal competition experience, check out [Longhorn Cube Day 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LonghornCubeDay2023).*** 

This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNFDenton2023#33525-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNFDenton2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 
	
To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
